en.headline: 23 own commits plus 32 automated, 5 issue interactions on anomalyco/opencode
en.summary: The user made **23 own commits** across three repositories, plus 32 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 17 commits advanced the codemap baseline, fixed the activity card to use a +08 natural-day window counting only public data, redrew `repo-overview.excalidraw` as a "三问矩阵", and added count pills to `docs/summary.html`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 4 commits fixed script gaps from a second review, derived the version badge from `SKILL.md`, added full inventory output for `discover-agents`, and made snapshot writes atomic. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 2 commits corrected outdated knowledge about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts, and Windows ports, and added remote-branch deletion checks. On `anomalyco/opencode`, the user commented on issues #50823 and #56113 (MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision and subagent failures), and closed #55785 (Go endpoint rejecting images) after commenting. No PRs, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 23 次本人提交另有 32 次自动提交，在 anomalyco/opencode 上互动 5 个 issue
zh.summary: 用户在三个仓库中共有 **23 次本人提交**，另有 32 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，17 次提交推进了 codemap 基线，将活动卡片改为 +08 自然日窗口且只统计公开数据，重画 `repo-overview.excalidraw` 为「三问矩阵」，并为 `docs/summary.html` 添加条数 pill。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 中，4 次提交修复了二次审查发现的脚本缺口，从 `SKILL.md` 派生版本徽章，为 `discover-agents` 输出完整清单，并使快照写入原子化。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，2 次提交修正了关于子命令列表、随包 skill 数量和 Windows 端口的过期结论，并补充了远程分支删除的检查与风险。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 上，用户评论了 #50823 和 #56113（MiMo-V2.6-Flash 视觉与子代理失败问题），并在评论后关闭了 #55785（Go 端点拒绝图片）。当日无 PR、review、release 或讨论活动。
